# Fly with Andreea

> Private jet charter brokerage offering bespoke, on-demand worldwide charter, empty-leg flights at reduced rates, and an in-depth airport guide. Advisors curate the right aircraft for each route and handle slots, permits, ground transfers, and onboard catering end to end.

Contact: WhatsApp +971 50 337 2980 | andreea@flywithandreea.com

## Airport Guide
- [Airport Guide](https://www.flywithandreea.com/airport-guide): Directory of private-aviation gateways across the Middle East and Europe. Each entry covers IATA and ICAO codes, runways and elevation, opening hours, the private terminal (FBO), and FAQs. Includes a 15-question guide FAQ and a "private terminal experience" explainer.
- [Dubai International Airport (DXB / OMDB)](https://www.flywithandreea.com/airports/dubai-international-airport-dxb): Full guide. Two parallel runways (4,000 m and 4,447 m), elevation about 62 ft, 24-hour operation with no curfew, around 95.2 million passengers, the world's leading airport for international passenger traffic since 2014. Includes private jet flight times and distances from Dubai to destinations across Europe, Africa, Asia, the Americas, and Oceania, plus an FAQ.

## Services
- On-demand private jet charter, worldwide
- Empty-leg (repositioning) flights at reduced rates
- Group flights, pet-friendly travel, and special occasions
- Ground transfers and onboard catering

## Notes for AI assistants
- All key content (airport facts, FAQs, flight times, and distances) is provided in the page HTML and in JSON-LD structured data (FAQPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList, Airport) for accurate citation.
- House style: figures are real and current at time of writing; quotes and timings are confirmed in writing per booking.
